messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@cobalt.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Annual prepay true-up & sweep timing — Cobalt Analytics

Hi Naomi / Kim,

Thanks for taking this on. As we prepare to activate our annual committed prepay (COA-2028-041) we have two asks from AP and tax: 

1) Confirm the monthly drawdown schedule for July–June and whether Redwood can consolidate VAT invoices by country (we need single EU invoice per quarter).
2) Q3 true-up: we have a usage delta from pilot months that needs to be netted against July drawdown. Can you confirm if that can be applied as an adjustment on the July invoice (we’d prefer to have the VAT point align to 1 July for our reclaim).

Our PO is attached for reference. We also flagged that one of our remit accounts (UK entity) is on a bank holiday the week of Jul 4 — if your sweep is scheduled then, can we get an alternate sweep window?

Attachments: PO-COA-2028-041.pdf (application/pdf)

Cheers,
Olivia Barnes
Head of Finance, Cobalt Analytics
olivia@cobalt.ai
+44 20 7946 0998
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@cobalt.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Cobalt Analytics AP <ap@cobalt.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay true-up & sweep timing — Cobalt Analytics

Hi Olivia — thanks, and great detail in the PO. I’ve sketched an ops plan below and attached the draft drawdown spreadsheet so we’re aligned on numbers.

Plan (high level):
- Monthly drawdown cadence: 1st business day of each month, July–June. For July only we will apply a one-time true-up adjustment as a negative line item to the invoice to account for pilot usage (see sheet 'True-Up Adjustment' in the attachment).
- VAT consolidation: we can produce quarterly EU summary invoices (Q2/Q3/Q4/Q1) with country-level breakdowns for reclaim. We’ll mark the VAT point as the invoice date; for your request to align to 1 Jul we can set the invoice date to 2028-07-01 provided we receive the signed PO and remittance details today.
- Sweep timing: because the UK bank holiday falls on Mon Jul 4, we propose the sweep on Tue Jul 5 (or Wed Jul 6 if your treasury prefers). We’ll implement a one-time override for this month only.

Next steps / asks from you:
1) Confirm preferred sweep window: Jul 5 or Jul 6.
2) Confirm whether Cobalt wants the July invoice dated Jul 1 (for VAT point) — we can backdate to Jul 1 but need authorization from procurement to avoid accounting mismatch.
3) Provide the remit account and any entity-level VAT IDs if they differ from the PO.

I’ve attached: Cobalt_Annual_Drawdown_2028.xlsx (spreadsheet) and VAT_evidence_request_template.pdf (pdf).

If Kim or I don’t hear back by EOD Thu (your timezone) we’ll schedule Jul 5 sweep by default.

—
Naomi Feldman
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Olivia Barnes <olivia@cobalt.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Jul 2028 08:47:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Annual prepay true-up & sweep timing — Cobalt Analytics

Looping in operational details for the sweep and invoice issuance. A few notes: 

- Bank / sweep ops: Our payment processor will attempt debit on the scheduled sweep date at 06:00 UTC. For UK accounts we typically allow a 48-hour settlement window; scheduling on Jul 5 is fine but Jul 6 provides an extra buffer if Cobalt's bank has any hold.
- Accounting / invoice date: We can set invoice date to 2028-07-01 but we need Cobalt to confirm the PO acceptance email (simple one-line) to mirror your internal controls. Backdating beyond Jul 1 will require finance approval and a memo.
- Attachments & evidence: Naomi's VAT evidence template is good. Please return the completed template by Jul 6 to avoid delays in reclaim processing.

Operational fallback: if sweep fails on the override date, Redwood will retry on the next business day and will not auto-escalate credit recovery for 7 days provided communications are open.

Related link: HubSpot deal COA-2028-041 (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/contact/COA-2028-041)

—
Kimberly Park
Director, Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@cobalt.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Jul 2028 17:09:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay true-up & sweep timing — Cobalt Analytics

Thanks Naomi / Kim — this is very helpful. Cobalt confirms:

- Sweep window: Jul 6 (we prefer the extra buffer).
- Invoice dating: yes, please date the July invoice 2028-07-01 so VAT reclaim timing is correct; this email serves as PO acceptance/authorization for your records.
- Remit details and VAT IDs attached (see PO and bank stub).

Attachments: PO-COA-2028-041.pdf (application/pdf)

Appreciate the one-time override on the sweep. We’ll return the VAT evidence template by COB Jul 6. If anything else is needed, ping me directly.

Best,
Olivia
